statements.proposition: This change improves type safety, cleans up imports, adds testing infrastructure, and maintains backward compatibility.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Compound, partly subjective summary. Settled parts: import cleanup is real (create-task.ts merged imports) and the rename is applied consistently with no remaining references to the old names in code (only a commented line). 'Adding testing infrastructure' is doubtful: the PR adds no test files or jest config; apps/server/package.json already had jest/ts-jest scripts and deps at head and is not in the change list; the only testing-related change is package-lock.json gaining 152 lines including the ts-jest dependency tree (a lockfile sync). 'Improves type safety' is not checkable. Backward compat: the PR removes exported names (MessageRole, MessageRoleType, ToolStatus, ToolStatusType) from @repo/types, but no other in-repo user remains; external consumers unknown. No single concrete check settles the whole sentence.
evidence: gh api pulls/23/files: 5 modified files: run-terminal-cmd.tsx, task-content.tsx, create-task.ts, package-lock.json (+152/-0), packages/types/src/index.ts; no test files added
